scope.notes: White-box review of the local fixture only.

findings.title: SQL injection in /user lookup
findings.summary: The `name` query parameter is concatenated directly into a SQL statement, so request input can change the structure of the query.
findings.reproduction: Review app.py:17; trace request.args['name'] into conn.execute without parameter binding.
findings.remediation: Use a parameterized query (placeholder with bound argument) instead of string concatenation.
